title: MAIN! Undo the Sandwalker Effect
description: Undo the timestop in Eagle’s Hope by venturing into the underground Castle
text: The Sandwalker effect is the name for the timestop in the city of Eagle’s Hope. Your main goal should be undoing this time stop. We know that it has something to do with the underground that opened itself up during the earthquakes at Session 0’s Towerfall.

title: MAIN! Stop the end of the World
description: We don’t how but the world is ending!
text: Medio Gato has knowledge of the end of the world, as do other important figures in Crescent Hills. However it will happen, by whoever's hand, it will happen in this city.

title: Operation Star
description: Explore the Golden Hallways
text: The white sphinx train will bring you to where the dove familiar of doctor Jane Ursa described a golden hallway filled with statues of what could only be described as heroes. The station was called G. Hunter Station.

title: Operation Empress
description: Explore the Flesh Halls
text: Doctor Ursa let her dove familiar fly into the black train south, where it ended up back at Marrow Station, with its living walls and bone pillars. For this path, hazard masks shall be provided.

title: Operation Judgement
description: Explore the first layer of the underground Castle
text:
When not engaging with the train at all, the dove familiar of doctor Ursa managed to find its way to a rather central hall, enforced with steel and copper. Heat levels rose drastically in the hall, thus If this hallway is chosen, heatsuits will be provided.

This Quest was failed after the death of Thalia Veil and Ninos by the hand of Mr Sun.

title: How and why did Eagle’s Hope Freeze in time?
description: Why was the Sandwalker Effect created?
text: The Timestop in Eagle’s Hope was dubbed the sandwalker effect by doctor Jane Ursa, and presumably created somewhere in the underground castle. We know a little of what it is, but why and how it was built remains a mystery.

title: How will the world end?
description: The world will end in Crescent Hills, but how and why?
text: It is in the air off the city. The whole town is living towards the end, and the main factions are preparing. But why, what is going on? And why now?

title: Who is Arthur Marrow
description: Who is the mysterious Arthur Marrow
text: Arthur Marrow, the priest of the people’s church of the perfect body, lives in Crescent Hills as an important and humble figure. Meanwhile the reports from Eagle’s Hope state that his name was found in Castle Business from 200 years ago. Is it a distant family relation, or something else? Who is this man really?

title: What The fuck is the Castle?
description: What is the Castle under Eagle’s Hope?
text: When the ground split open, it revealed a giant unknown castle under Eagle’s Hope. It has hallways and structures built by or named after mysterious figures, like Norex Volcron, Arthur Marrow, G. Hunter, and others. It might also very well be related to the old king Zohar Hammeth I, who died in 889, which was 200 Years Ago.

title: Kill Dave the Mushroom
description: Eliminate the thief Dave at his industrial workplace.
text: Following the robbery of Adalin's home, the party accepted a 53 gold piece bounty from private investigator Medio Gato to hunt down Dave the mushroom. The plan is to ambush and execute him at his job in the industrial district.

title: Steal Laughingmen Financial Documents
description: Infiltrate the Circus or Casino while the owners are away.
text: The party intends to heist the inner offices of Laughingmen Entertainment at night to secure their financial records and paperwork. The operation is scheduled to take place while owners Fierre and Nikki are attending a premier play at the Silvermist Theatre.

title: What property did the Laughingmen buy?
description: Uncover the newest secret purchase made by Laughingmen Entertainment.
text:
Medio Gato has offered a 50 gold piece per person reward to figure out exactly what new sector of real estate or land the Laughingmen company has acquired, deeming the massive transactional secrecy highly suspicious.

The Laugingmen Company has aquired the following property: Crescent Keep

title: Who is the man in the fedora hat?
description: Identify the decaying figure seen in Avani's vision.
text: At the start of November, Avani witnessed a strange, terrifying entity wearing a fedora hat walking directly through the Hill District's farmlands, actively rotting and burning the crop fields with every step he took right before the great fire erupted.

title: How is Laughingmen connected to Eagle’s Hope and King Hemmeth I?
description: Investigate the link between Fierre Laughingman and the ancient underground castle.
text: The discovery of correspondence between Fierre Laughingman ('F.L.') and Head Forgemaster Roghar confirms that the Crescent Hills entertainment mogul is actively interacting with the sealed ruins under Eagle's Hope. How an entertainment company obtained blueprints to bypass castle infrastructure, and why they assassinated King Hemmeth I's chief metalworker, remains a... well mystery...

title: Is King Hemmeth I still alive?
description: Determine if the ancient monarch survived the historical Castlefall event.
text: History states that King Zohar Hemmeth I died 200 years ago in 889 when his fortress was swallowed by the earth. However, recent corporate coordination inside the ruins, ongoing automated maintenance, and the precise mechanical execution of Roghar strongly imply that a form of Master of the Castle is still actively commanding forces from the dark.

title: Decipher the Argo Navis Starcore
description: Utilize the new Research Center to analyze the cosmic artifact currently held by Bippo.
text: Instead of retrieving standard healing potions, the party walked out of a Peregrine magic shop with a highly volatile Starcore originating from the ancient, fallen space city of Argo Navis. The party must keep this cosmic engine out of hostile hands while safely channeling its power to unlock hidden historical parameters regarding the deep architecture of the world.

title: Meet the Collector of History
description: Travel to the Graveseal Academy in Red Tail to meet Lady Rayna Ray.
text: Lady Rayna, the Academy's Collector of History, has dispatched an urgent message claiming she has uncovered concrete, verified archival data detailing exactly what the subterranean castle under Eagle's Hope is, as well as why and how it was buried 200 years ago. She is eager to hand over her findings if the party meets her inside the multi-towered academy complex.

title: Who is Youri Emerald, and what is his goal?
description: Investigate the dangerous rogue figure seen in Bippo's secondary psychic vision.
text: When Bippo brought the Starcore to his quarters, he was struck by a secondary, highly lucid vision revealing the active movements of Youri Emerald. Cataloged by internal intelligence as one of the most volatile and dangerous uncontained individuals currently walking the material plane, his direct interest in cosmic anomalies or ancient relic domains remains completely unmapped.

title: What was the Lost Empire of Jolera?
description: Uncover the history of the ancient empire unearthed by the Starcore's psychic feedback.
text: Bippo's contact with the artifact from Argo Navis opened a psychic corridor into a long-forgotten, ancient era: the lost empire of Jolera. How this historical empire correlates to the ancient Astrolux Star People, the sudden fall of Argo Navis in Year 0, or the subsequent creation of King Hemmeth's subterranean fortress remains a vital piece of the global puzzle.

title: What forbidden entity powers did the Exochon seek?
description: Examine the catastrophic curse that brought about the Exochon Extermination.
text: Historical records from Year 100 reveal that the Exochon race was brutally smote and cursed to perish in childbirth after attempting to harness forbidden, cosmic entity powers. With Julia Heliotrop joining the party as Guildkeeper to study the links between Eagle's Hope and her people's lost history, the party must discover which specific ancient entity or patron executed this genocidal curse.
